'''Clue scroll (medium)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (medium)|medium]] [[Treasure Trails]].

When searching the drawers, the chatbox message "The drawers are locked!  A note left on the drawers reads: Don't forget to feed the chickens." is displayed, hinting that you must kill a [[chicken]] to get the key.
